City-centre locators and documented relationships. Lines are not transport routes.
Vice-president office; old works recommended for
HAER AL-32, printed pp19,21 / PDF pp21,23
Bessemer did not adopt centrifugal casting until 1934; no centrifugal icon before that year.
Birmingham centrifugal adoption date is unspecified.
ACIPCO is a separate company; this map must not imply its control by USCIP&F.
Cleveland, Buffalo and Louisville are proposed closures in the 1913 report, not proven closure dates.
Louisville is both an office location and the site of works recommended for abandonment.
Selected locations, not the complete company plant or office network; no full North/South site count implied.
